speakers.speaker: 甄嬛
speakers.speaker_description: young#female#后宫妃嫔，沈眉庄的好姐妹，本集向眉庄解释自己提议复原仇敌年氏位分的原因

speakers.speaker: 沈眉庄
speakers.speaker_description: young#female#后宫妃嫔，甄嬛的姐姐，因甄嬛提议给华妃复位一事感到不解和痛心

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_zh: 姐姐宫里怎么连个人影都没有？
dialogue.text_en: Why is there no one here, sister?

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: Where are the servants?

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: Why are they not serving you?

dialogue.speaker: 沈眉庄
dialogue.text_zh: 今儿是宫中发放夏衣的日子，
dialogue.text_en: Today the palace gives out summer clothes.

dialogue.speaker: 沈眉庄
dialogue.text_zh: 我让他们去内务府领了。
dialogue.text_en: I sent them to the office to get them.

dialogue.speaker: 沈眉庄
dialogue.text_zh: 比不得你宫里家大业大，
dialogue.text_en: Not like your place, so grand and busy.

dialogue.speaker: 沈眉庄
dialogue.text_en: Everyone rushes to go there.

dialogue.speaker: 沈眉庄
dialogue.text_zh: 连内务府主事的姜公公
dialogue.text_en: Even Chief Jiang from the office

dialogue.speaker: 沈眉庄
dialogue.text_zh: 都亲自上门送奴才们的衣裳。
dialogue.text_en: came personally to deliver the servants' clothes.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: I know.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_zh: 姐姐不是在意皇上的宠幸。
dialogue.text_en: You are not concerned about the Emperor's favor.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: You say this,

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_zh: 可是为了华妃复位一事？
dialogue.text_en: is it about restoring Hua Fei?

dialogue.speaker: 沈眉庄
dialogue.text_en: Fine.

dialogue.speaker: 沈眉庄
dialogue.text_en: Then I ask you,

dialogue.speaker: 沈眉庄
dialogue.text_zh: 华妃复位之事，是不是你向皇上提议？
dialogue.text_en: Did you suggest to the Emperor to restore Hua Fei?

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: But sister,

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: I had no choice.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_zh: 谁愿意捧了杀了自己孩子的仇敌上位？
dialogue.text_en: Who would want to elevate the enemy who killed my child?

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: Please think for me, sister.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: If I were not forced,

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: why would I do this?

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: What you cannot bear,

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_zh: 妹妹我身受之苦并不亚于姐姐，
dialogue.text_en: my suffering is no less [painful] than yours.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: Do you think I can bear it?

dialogue.speaker: 沈眉庄
dialogue.text_en: Then why did you do it?

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: Sister, think,

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: to appease Nian Gengyao,

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_zh: 皇上迟早会复年世兰的分位，
dialogue.text_en: The Emperor will restore Nian Shilan rank.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: At least to the rank of Hua Fei.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: If forced by the situation,

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_zh: 只怕封个贵妃也不是不可能的。
dialogue.text_en: she could even become a higher consort.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_zh: 纵使姐姐今日得太后欢心，
dialogue.text_en: Even if you have the Empress Dowager's favor today,

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: I still could not stop it.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: Rather than that,

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: better let me be the one to suggest it.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_zh: 宁可皇上因为我而给她加封时有更多的无奈和愧疚。
dialogue.text_en: Better the Emperor feels more helpless and guilty when granting her because of me.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: The more he feels this,

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: the more secure my position becomes.

dialogue.speaker: 沈眉庄
dialogue.text_en: Even though you explain so clearly,

dialogue.speaker: 沈眉庄
dialogue.text_en: I still do not understand.

dialogue.speaker: 沈眉庄
dialogue.text_en: She is Hua Fei today,

dialogue.speaker: 沈眉庄
dialogue.text_zh: 明儿成了贵妃，岂非更加简单？
dialogue.text_en: As Noble Consort, she would be unstoppable.

dialogue.speaker: 沈眉庄
dialogue.text_en: Even if you scheme every step,

dialogue.speaker: 沈眉庄
dialogue.text_zh: 可是她未必步步走入你算计之中啊。
dialogue.text_en: she may not step into your trap every time.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: At some point, I do not know when,

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: I have become [skillful] at scheming,

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: selfish and cold.

dialogue.speaker: 沈眉庄
dialogue.text_en: I know.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_zh: 我已不是善良单纯的人了。
dialogue.text_en: I am no longer that kind and simple person.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: But what I did

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_zh: 的确是有不好马上说出口的道理。
dialogue.text_en: truly has reasons I cannot say right away.

vocab_cards.speaker: 甄嬛
vocab_cards.original_sentence: My suffering is no less painful than yours.
vocab_cards.explanation_zh: painful的意思是痛苦的。原句是 My suffering is no less painful than yours. 简单例句是 The cut was very painful.

vocab_cards.speaker: 甄嬛
vocab_cards.original_sentence: I have become skillful at scheming.
vocab_cards.simple_sentence: She is a skillful piano player.
vocab_cards.explanation_zh: skillful的意思是熟练的，灵巧的。原句是 I have become skillful at scheming. 简单例句是 She is a skillful piano player.
